Feature: Is there an overt marker for the absolutive?
Comment: No overt absolutive marker; NOM-ACC language.
curated_comment: In Bilibil (bilb1241, ISO bpz, Austronesian, PNG), grammatical relations are expressed through word order in a nominative-accusative pattern. Subjects are stated to be marked optionally with posposition "mos" and tend to take this marker when the object if fronted for emphasis, but this word order is not necessary for the subject to take this marker. The few examples available have "mos" marked on A arguments only; there is not enough evidence to assert that this is an ergative marker.  All 24 ERGON features are 0. Glottocode bilb1241 is correct (the filename was renamed from X_bilb1241=bilb1241.xlsx as part of Category E curation). File moved to non_ergative/.
